name: AB Veh Take
author: Abu Bakar Siddique

sections.description:
AB Veh Take is a robust vehicle and journey booking plugin designed for transport services, taxis, and private drivers. It provides a seamless front-end booking experience that integrates beautifully with your theme.

Major features include:
* One-Way & Multi-Stop Bookings: Let your customers request standard A-to-B journeys, or complex multi-stop routes with wait times.
* Elementor Integration: Includes the “AB Veh Take Form” Elementor widget so you can drag, drop, and style your booking form visually.
* Shortcode Support: Easily embed the form anywhere using [ab_veh_take_form].
* Admin Dashboard: A dedicated backend area to manage, approve, or delete booking requests with bulk actions.
* Availability Calendar: Define custom availability (Wide, Limited, Unavailable) for specific dates or weekends.
* Customization: Fully customize colors, typography, vehicle types, layout dimensions, and all form text labels directly from the settings page.
* Email Notifications: Sends instant confirmation emails to customers and admin alerts for new bookings.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ab-veh-take directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the AB Veh Take -> Settings screen to configure your admin email, colors, and text.
  4. Place the “AB Veh Take Form” Elementor widget or [ab_veh_take_form] shortcode on any page.
sections.faq:
How do I change the vehicle types?

Navigate to the “AB Veh Take -> Settings -> General” page in your WordPress admin. There, you can add, remove, or rename the vehicle types offered in the booking form.

What shortcode should I use?

Use [ab_veh_take_form].

Are emails not sending?

If you are testing on a local server, emails may not send. On a live server, the plugin uses the standard WordPress wp_mail() function. Ensure your server is configured to send emails, or use a dedicated SMTP plugin for maximum reliability.
sections.changelog:
1.7.0

  • Renamed plugin folder to ab-veh-take to match WordPress.org slug requirements.
  • Bumped version to 1.7.0 for new WordPress.org submission.

1.6.0

  • Renamed plugin to AB Veh Take (slug: ab-veh-take).
  • Introduced [ab_veh_take_form] shortcode and “AB Veh Take Form” Elementor widget.
  • Fixed PHP compatibility: resolved fatal error on PHP < 8.2 by using cross-version date validation.
  • Fixed admin booking list table bulk actions (approve, pending, delete).
  • Fixed vehicle types reset: clearing the list now properly resets to defaults.
  • Increased database vehicle_type column length to VARCHAR(100) to prevent MySQL strict mode truncation errors.
  • Fixed email display bug showing “(wait 0 mins)” on stops with no wait time.
  • Fixed time validation to accept optional seconds (HH:MM:SS).
  • Improved settings layout descriptions.

1.5.3

  • Fixed frontend styles and JavaScript initialization in Elementor editor previews and dynamically rendered shortcode instances.

1.5.2

  • Added strict server-side booking validation, honeypot spam protection, and per-IP submission throttling.
  • Added safe uninstall cleanup for plugin tables and options; synchronized the WordPress.org stable tag.
  • Hardened settings and Elementor value normalization, availability date validation, and bulk-action redirects.
  • Improved keyboard accessibility for journey tabs and calendar navigation.
  • Colors and layout now upgrade automatically on activation/update.
